adjudication_label: experimental artifacts and interpretation of surface-sensitive measurements
canonical_question: Could the difference in penetration depth between 3 h (893.9 nm) and 50 h (842.6 nm) be attributed to differences in sample surface roughness rather than bulk properties?

question_variants.question: Could the difference in penetration depth between 3 h (893.9 nm) and 50 h (842.6 nm) be attributed to differences in sample surface roughness rather than bulk properties?
question_variants.resolution_summary: No grounded answer was selected from the eligible evidence.
source_evidence_spans: The highest penetration depth (893.9 ± 5.2 nm) was achieved by the alloy produced from 3 h milled feedstock powders in comparison with the lowest penetration depth of 842.6 ± 3.6 nm of the bulk produced with 50 h milled powders.
